_comments.note: Keys starting with _ are documentation only — ignored by the script.
_comments.baseUrl: Media API root URL (APIM or local).

filter.description: Sent as JSON body to POST /v2/Documents/metadata.
filter.space: Optional. One of: Area, Item, Issue
filter.areaIdPrefix: Optional. Return media whose area number starts with this prefix.

_comments.outputPath: Working folder for photos and index. Supports {timestamp}.
_comments.outputFileName: Optional ZIP name inside outputPath. Default: media-extract-{timestamp}.zip
_comments.progressEvery: Log download progress every N photos.
